title: Ramesh Kumar vs State of U.P.
full_text: The petitioner was charged under section 420 for alleged fraud in a property transaction. The prosecution presented evidence including bank statements and witness testimony. The defense argued lack of intent and procedural lapses in the investigation. The matter has been listed for final arguments after all evidence was recorded over six hearings.

title: Neha Sharma vs Raj Sharma
full_text: This is a matrimonial dispute involving contested custody of a minor child. Both parties have filed affidavits and the court has directed a mediation attempt which failed. Evidence stage is ongoing with witness examination scheduled.

title: ABC Pvt Ltd vs XYZ Corp
full_text: A commercial dispute regarding breach of a supply contract. The plaintiff claims damages for non-delivery of goods as per agreed terms. Both parties have concluded arguments and the matter is reserved for orders.

title: Suresh Patel vs Municipal Corp
full_text: A property dispute concerning unauthorized construction notice issued by the municipal corporation. The petitioner has just filed the case and it is at the admission stage pending notice to the respondent.

title: State Bank of India vs Mohan Verma
full_text: A loan recovery suit filed by the bank against a defaulting borrower. The case is at an early stage with charges yet to be framed regarding the extent of liability.

title: State of Delhi vs Vikram Singh
full_text: An appeal against conviction under the Indian Penal Code for criminal breach of trust. The Supreme Court examined the evidentiary record from the trial and appellate courts and upheld the conviction while modifying the sentence considering mitigating circumstances presented by the defense.

title: Global Textiles Ltd vs Commissioner of Income Tax
full_text: A tax dispute regarding disallowance of certain business expenses. The apex court ruled in favor of the assessee, holding that the expenses were legitimately incurred for business purposes and were wrongly disallowed by the tax authorities.
